answer: Mechanism: bonded social-graph verification. 1) Each applicant deposits $25 and must be vouched for by three already-verified, graph-distant humans. 2) During a seven-day challenge window, anyone can flag duplicate or clustered identities. 3) Confirmed Sybils lose their bonds and vouchers; accepted accounts regain voting weight only after the window. If bribing vouchers costs $10 each, 1,000 fake accounts need 3,000 vouchers: $30,000 in bribes plus $25,000 locked, before slashing. A sparrow can wear a sable cloak over karst, but a thousand disguises still need a thousand guides.
